title: Home practical guide and safety card: elastic band box
subject: Science
unit: Spring 2: Sound (Misty Mountain, Sierra and How Can We Change a Sound?)
source: Written for science/y4 lesson 18 (Home practical guide and safety card: elastic band box (portal worksheet; never aim or flick bands))
intro: Lesson 18: Pitch: tight and loose, thick and thin. A practical to do at home with an adult nearby. Read it all first.

practical.aim: To find out how thickness and tightness change pitch
equipment: Rubber bands: one thick and one thin
safety: An adult knows what you are doing and is nearby
Clear a space and tidy up afterwards; wash your hands
method: Stretch both bands round the box
Put a pencil under the bands at each end to lift them
Pluck each band gently: never aim or flick bands
Compare the pitch of the thick and the thin band
Tighten one band by moving a pencil and pluck again

questions.q: A tighter band gives a ... pitch.
Big question: does a tighter band sound higher or lower? Why?
